diagnostics.message: 'implementedBy' is legal at L4 (object) and L5 (member) only. L1-L3 are organisational and never reference the model — move the links to a nested L4 child.
nested under "Reliability" (level 2) but declares level 1. Nesting is the hierarchy — a child sits strictly below its parent.
level must be an integer 1-5 (got 7). L1 solution, L2 segment (app/library), L3 service, L4 object, L5 member. On an architectural requirement the level is optional — omit it for a flat policy.
